The '''''Consular III''-class space cruiser''' was a model of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to [[Transport/Legends|transport]] [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomats]] to troubled spots across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] that led up to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was distinguishable by its [[Color/Legends|red]] [[Hull/Legends|hull]] and its unusual design, harking back to the [[Boat/Legends|sailing ships]] of ancient [[Time/Legends|times]]. At least [[Blood Brother|one]] such [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] was captured and modified into a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] ship.

==Characteristics==
The ''Consular III''-class [[Realspace/Legends|space]] [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] was a [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] conceived by the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]].<ref name="Corellian" /> It was used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to provide safe [[Transport/Legends|transport]] for its [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomats]]. Following old Republican conventions,<ref name="E1:ICS">''[[Star Wars: Episode I Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref> its [[Hull/Legends|hull]] was coated in [[Color/Legends|crimson]] to denote the vessel's status of neutrality.<ref name="EOTJ" /> The cruiser was shaped like one of the archaic [[Boat/Legends|sailing ships]] that were used for [[Water/Legends|aquatic]] transport prior to space travel.<ref name="SWD3" /> Even though the design of the ''Consular III'' differed drastically from usual construction, it was no unicum. Vessels with similar designs were built throughout galactic history, such as the ''[[Fairwind]]'', a large [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] once owned by [[Jedi Lord]] and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Valenthyne Farfalla]],<ref name="JVS">''[[Star Wars: Jedi vs. Sith]]''</ref> or the ''[[Merriweather]]'', a [[Bulk cruiser/Legends|bulk cruiser]] of [[Tof/Legends|Tof]] make.<ref name="M107">[[Star Wars (1977) 107|''Star Wars'' (1977) 107]]</ref>

==History==
The ''Consular III'' belonged to the same line as the earlier [[Consular-class light cruiser/Legends|''Consular''-class cruiser]],<ref name="JCF">{{JCFCite|url=posts/50806562|board=Literature|thread=What's This? More Droids from Handley and Peña?|user=Halagad_Ventor|date=2013-04-11|time=1:15 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20180316143733/http://boards.theforce.net/threads/whats-this-more-droids-from-handley-and-pe%C3%B1a.50012958/page-2}}</ref> which was put into service by [[990 BBY]]<ref name="Rule of Two">''[[Darth Bane: Rule of Two]]''</ref> and was still used around the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="E1:ICS" /> By the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> a ''Consular III'' cruiser christened the [[Blood Brother|''Dura-Khan III'']] had been claimed as booty by the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] named [[Reddjak]], who had modified it for piracy and renamed it ''Blood Brother''.<ref name="EOTJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Echoes of the Jedi was a project done on a very tight schedule, and the discrepancy you refer to had gotten through.|Abel Peña, explaing why the name ''Consular III'' was invented|<ref name="JCF" />}}
[[File:Republic_Cruiser.png|thumb|left|150px|The ''Blood Brother'' was originally retconned into a Mark I ''Consular''-class cruiser.]]
The pirate ship ''Blood Brother'' was the first ''Consular III''-class cruiser to appear in a ''[[Star Wars]]'' product. It was featured in the [[1986]] story [[Droids (1986) 3|''The Scarlet Pirate'']], the third issue of the [[Star Wars: Droids (1986)|''Star Wars: Droids'']] series of comics, although its class went unmentioned at the time.<ref name="SWD3" /> The ''Blood Brother'' was first identified as a ''Consular''-class cruiser in ''[[Dawn of Defiance]]'', a [[2007]] campaign for [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s version of the [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]].<ref name="EOTJ" />

However, the vessel's appearance differed significantly<ref name="SWD3" /> from that of the [[Radiant VII/Legends|''Radiant VII'']], a ''Consular''-class cruiser seen in [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']].<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref> To resolve that discrepancy,<ref name="JCF" /> the class to which the ''Blood Brother'' belonged was later renamed ''Consular III'' by [[Abel G. Peña]] and [[Rich Handley]] in the first part of "[[The Droids Re-Animated]]," a pair of reference articles at the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|blog]].<ref name="tdr-a" />
